title: Record the uniform reservoir constant 3 r_max / p (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped comparison. No new κ. The selected conditional exponent stays `60403/20000000`, and PR #4100 is not accepted.

Every layout accepted by the #4174 constructor has `G ≥ 256`. The constructor requires `p ≥ 1` and `ell ≥ max(2, ceil(log2(p+2)))`, and `ceil(log2(p+2)) ≥ 2`, so

```text
G = 64 (ell + ceil(log2(p+2))) ≥ 256.
```

The floor is achieved at `p = 1`, `ell = 2`, and 65,536 widths of 1: `G = 256`, `L = 65536`, `r_max = 2`.

For `G ≥ 256` the factored sharp term `2 + 2^{1−62G} − 2^{2−63G}` is strictly less than 3. At `r = r_max`,

```text
r (2/B + β) < (3 r_max / p) p 2^{-G}.
```

The same bound covers the published window term. On the equality case the constant is 6, and both `C = 1` and `C = 1/6400` fail. When the layout also has `L ≤ p`, `3 r_max / p ≤ 3/25600 < 1/6400`, so the older constant still covers those layouts. The production plan `r_max = 5`, `p = 9240576` satisfies the tighter majorant.

## Task and overlap

- Base: canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, fetched 2026-10-22T23:52:56Z, priority revision 7.
- Card: `formal-interface-lemma`, scope **refined**. This is the open question of PR #4921.
- Predecessor: PR #4174 for the constructor. PR #4646 for the factored term. PR #4921 for the single layout `p = 2`.
- Package: `research/crt-reservoir-uniform-constant/`.
- Overlap at 2026-10-22T23:52:52Z: this package and PR #4921's open question. No other proof that `G ≥ 256` for every accepted layout.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-reservoir-uniform-constant
```

Observed `PASS_CRT_RESERVOIR_UNIFORM_CONSTANT G_min=256 equality_p=1 equality_r=2 integer_factor=3`, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/crt-reservoir-uniform-constant outcome=completed`.

Not run: a layout census, the 104,864-plan schedule, the `E` product, Lean, and Docker.

## Open next questions

1. On the equality-case layout `p = 1`, `ell = 2`, `r_max = 2`, `G = 256`, what does `3 r_max 2^{-G}` times the printed `E` envelope become? First step: multiply `6 · 2^{-256}` by `2^{4 ell} (p+2)^{16}` and compare with `2^{-60 ell} (p+2)^{-48}`.
